SMAA (Enhanced Subpixel Morphological Antialiasing), reference implementation
https://github.com/iryoku/smaa, commit 71c806a838bdd7d517df19192a20f0c61b3ca29d
MIT (LICENSE.txt: the copyright notice and permission notice must stay with
copies of the source; binaries need not carry them).

Vendored unmodified: SMAA.hlsl, Textures/AreaTex.h (160x560, RG8) and
Textures/SearchTex.h (64x16, R8) as AreaTex.h and SearchTex.h, LICENSE.txt.

src/video/smaa_hlsl.inc is SMAA.hlsl with its comments taken out, as a C
string, made by make_inc.py from the file here (the licence notice is kept at
its head); run it again to update. src/video/smaa.c adapts that one source to
Metal's shading language by exact text substitutions and uses it as it is for
GLSL.
